name: VALPROATE SEMISODIUM (EQUIVALENT TO 500MG OF VALPROIC ACID) 30 DELAYED-RELEASE TABLETS
description: Sodium valproate is indicated as monotherapy and adjunctive treatment for complex partial seizures and simple and complex absence seizures in adults and pediatric patients 10 years of age and older. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
